open_review_survivor.eligibility: open follow_up_registry entry created only by SURVIVE or BORDERLINE adversarial review

failed_execution_retry.eligibility: latest durable target-history status is failed and at least three exact executable nights remain

recovered_coverage_retry.eligibility: committed insufficient_coverage target now has at least three exact executable nights

exclusions: success or null_result without an open follow_up_registry entry
actioned, dismissed, or expired follow_up_registry entries
targets with fewer than three exact executable nights
ordering: tier base descending, then within-tier value descending, then RA and Dec ascending

evidence.supports: SURVIVE and BORDERLINE are the only review outcomes that create an open scientific follow-up obligation.
Candidate follow-up value is explicitly distinct from discovery priority and increases for brighter, shorter-arc, lower-orbit-quality candidates.
Failed execution is durable retry evidence while success and null_result close the ordinary search obligation.

limitations: Within-tier followup_value is deterministic and explainable but not calibrated to a future recovery probability.
Tier ordering is a product-state contract: unresolved reviewed candidates outrank execution retries; it is not a scientific probability model.
Absolute value is reported separately and never used as a threshold that suppresses the best available eligible top-N.
